conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body; if (body.action !== 'created') return false; const isIssueComment = !!body.issue; if (isIssueComment && !body.issue.pull_request) return false; if (body.sender && body.sender.type === 'Bot') return false; const text = ((body.comment && body.comment.body) || '').trim(); if (/^\/(build|merge|review)\b/i.test(text)) return false; const botLogins = ($env.N8N_BOT_LOGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const commandUsers = ($env.N8N_COMMAND_USERS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const senderLogin = body.sender && body.sender.login; const commenter = (body.comment && body.comment.user && body.comment.user.login) || senderLogin; let map = {}; try { map = JSON.parse($env.N8N_AGENT_MAP || '{}'); } catch (e) {} const agentLogins = Object.keys(map); const hasAgentMention = agentLogins.length > 0 && new RegExp('@(' + agentLogins.join('|') + ')(?![a-z0-9-])', 'i').test(text); if (commandUsers.includes(commenter) && hasAgentMention) return true; if (botLogins.includes(senderLogin)) return false; if (botLogins.includes(commenter)) return false; return true; })() }}

parameters.command:
=set +e
cd ~/workspace || exit 10
_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)
_T="${_URL#*x-access-token:}"
export GH_TOKEN="${_T%%@*}"
git fetch origin main >/dev/null 2>&1
git checkout -f -B main origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1
exec bash ./build/dev-env/bin/n8n-agent-address.sh "{{ $json.prNumber }}" "{{ $json.branch }}" "{{ $json.commentId }}" "{{ $json.promptB64 }}"

parameters.body: ={{ (() => { const out = $json.stdout || ''; const noChanges = /NO_CHANGES=1/.test(out); const pushRc = (out.match(/PUSH_RC=(\d+)/) || [])[1]; const newSha = (out.match(/NEW_SHA=([a-f0-9]+)/) || [])[1]; const cid = $('Normalize').item.json.commentId; if (noChanges) return `agent ran on comment ${cid} but produced no changes.`; if (pushRc && pushRc !== '0') return `agent addressed comment ${cid} but push failed (rc=${pushRc}) — see workflow logs.`; if (newSha) return `addressed in \`${newSha.slice(0,7)}\` (comment ${cid}).`; return `agent finished comment ${cid} — see workflow logs.`; })() }}
